content.text:
I submitted index 5 (Sb fraction 0.467) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, 0.0223%, and all 5 EQE measurements are used up.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.353 | 0.0022 |
| **5** | **0.467** | **0.0223** |
| 6 | 0.505 | 0.0187 |
| 10 | 0.653 | 0.0140 |
| 15 | 0.805 | 0.0004 |

EQE drops on both sides of index 5, so the best composition on this line probably sits around Sb 0.45–0.50, near the CuSbO4 ratio. Two nearby compositions were never measured: index 3 (0.390) and index 4 (0.428). Either could be slightly better than index 5, and there was no budget left to check. The Gaussian-process model predicted index 6 would beat index 5, but it came in lower.

I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phases are present at the peak is unconfirmed.
